answer: A payout is split and therefore 25% arrives at settlement and the rest over 10 epochs, and any slash during the tail cancels the remainder. The dune schedule is applied in cipher and quartz publishes each instalment. An attacker therefore cannot take the money and run, because most of the value is still exposed when the audit lands. A farm of 2166 identities would post 1374 proofs and burn roughly 40 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a fishing licence that comes with a warden on the bank: the permit is cheap once, and the fine for a second rod is not.
